correctness.rationale: For SG_{4,2}, cyclically stable 4-subsets of Z/10 give exactly 25 vertices and 60 disjointness edges. Independent-set masks reconstruct f=(25,240,1160,3140,5079,5160,3370,1380,320,32), 19,907 faces including empty. I independently implemented the specific 16-pivot face matching from verify_homotopy.py and checked all 110,730 Hasse incidences in an acyclic topological sort (19,907 processed). Exactly 9,952 augmented pairs and three augmented critical cells remain; the empty pair yields an ordinary critical vertex, with one critical 3-cell and two 4-cells. Exact integer recursive projection of both critical 4-boundaries onto the 3-cell gives (0,0). Since each attaching map S^3→S^3 is classified by integral degree, the Morse CW complex is S^3∨S^4∨S^4. These exhaustive finite computations, not mod-two Betti numbers alone, prove the finite homotopy result.
